ns2:course.label: Sculpture I
ns2:course.description: Introduction to basic concepts, processes, and materials in sculpture, with an emphasis on the relationship among these three aspects of producing works of art. Prerequisite: ARTF 102 and ARTF 104.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of $55 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: Undergrad Sculpture A D $55.00 Flat Fee.
